name: context-engineering
description: Plugins for running a governed context layer for AI agents: load canon by contract, report gaps instead of editing, curate pages owner-gated, keep clients isolated, and set the whole thing up by interview.

plugins.name: context-engineering-setup
plugins.description: Interview-driven setup: recommends a platform stack from what you already run, then walks the canon, contract, gap tracker, catalog, sync and (for consultancies) client hubs step by step.

plugins.name: company-context
plugins.description: Read side, installed broadly: load the company canon by contract (bundle first, live fallback), assert only grounded pages, cite URLs, fetch numbers from Layer 3, and report gaps instead of editing.

plugins.name: context-curator
plugins.description: Write side, for a few curators: draft canon pages from evidence with CONFIRM markers, migrate a legacy wiki by disposition table, and check a session for drift against the Handbook. Owner-gated; never grounds a page itself.

plugins.name: client-context
plugins.description: Consultancy pattern: load one client's context contract and project manifest, refuse every source outside the client boundary, draft status rows as Agent (draft), and run the publishing checklist before anything reaches a portal.
